actual.descripcion: A comic tale of love set in the gold fields of turn-of-the-century Alaska, where two prospectors have made a fortune. One is about to marry and while he puts the finishing touches to the honeymoon cabin, the other travels to Seattle to collect the bride. When the latter discovers that the girl has married someone else, he decides to find his partner another bride.

siguiente.descripcion: Gunslinger Cole Thornton rides into a small town to work for a cattle baron, but quits after learning that his would-be employer wants to drive a family off their land and obtain their water supply. Thornton leaves the situation unresolved, but a chance encounter takes him back to El Dorado, where he joins the sheriff in a range war.

A mysterious stranger rides into a small frontier town in the American southwest, provoked into a gunfight in which he kills three men, and then begged by the townsfolk to become sheriff. The residents are terrified of the gunslinger but live in greater fear of a gang which intends to wipe out the whole town.
